article_title: Wales could ban steel pylons as government launches consultation

tasks.prompt: What policy is the Welsh government consulting on?
options: Requiring all wind farms to close by 2030
Making underground cables the first choice and banning traditional steel pylons for certain new lines
Replacing every wooden pole in Wales with a steel tower
Stopping all new electricity connections across rural Wales
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההתייעצות עוסקת במדיניות שלפיה הטמנת כבלים תהיה ברירת המחדל, ובאיסור עמודי פלדה מסורתיים בקווים חדשים מסוימים.
tasks.correct_answer: Making underground cables the first choice and banning traditional steel pylons for certain new lines

tasks.prompt: Which new power lines would the proposed ban cover?
options: Only household telephone lines
Every existing National Grid line
New lines up to 132 kV that are under Welsh government control
Only lines built outside Wales
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, ההצעה נוגעת לקווים חדשים עד 132 קילו־וולט שנמצאים בסמכות ממשלת ויילס.
tasks.correct_answer: New lines up to 132 kV that are under Welsh government control

tasks.prompt: In this article, what does “underground first” mean?
options: Construction must begin below sea level.
Underground cables should be the preferred option unless they are not feasible.
The public may not see the consultation documents.
Old electricity lines must be buried immediately.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי underground first מתאר העדפה ראשונית להטמנת כבלים, עם חלופות כאשר הדבר אינו מעשי.
tasks.correct_answer: Underground cables should be the preferred option unless they are not feasible.

tasks.prompt: According to Green Gen Cymru, how much more does undergrounding cost on average than overhead lines?
options: About twice as much
About three times as much
About ten times as much
About 4.5 times as much
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Green Gen Cymru טענה שהטמנת קווים עולה בממוצע פי 4.5 מקווים עיליים.

tasks.prompt: Why does the proposal allow wooden poles or similar infrastructure in some places?
options: Underground cables may not be practical everywhere.
Wooden poles always carry more electricity.
Steel pylons are already illegal throughout the UK.
Local residents asked for taller structures.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החריג מאפשר חלופות פחות בולטות כאשר הטמנה אינה ישימה מבחינה מעשית.
tasks.correct_answer: Underground cables may not be practical everywhere.

options: 15 November 2026
1 January 2027
15 January 2027
30 March 2027
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שההתייעצות פתוחה עד 15 בינואר 2027.

tasks.prompt: Give two benefits of underground cables mentioned in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי תועלות מדויקות מתוך הכתבה.
expected_points: They reduce visual impact and protect landscapes or local amenity.
They are less vulnerable to severe weather.
They can have a lower impact on birds and wildlife.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the disagreement over how new Welsh power lines should be built. Include the main argument on each side.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להציג את היתרונות הסביבתיים/נופיים של הטמנה ואת טענת העלות והצורך בגמישות מצד היזמים.
expected_points: Supporters say underground cables better protect landscapes, communities and wildlife.
Developers say undergrounding is much more expensive and no single design suits every route.
The government proposes an underground-first approach with less intrusive alternatives where needed.

tasks.prompt: Why might campaigners support new electricity infrastructure but oppose particular routes or structures? Use evidence from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההבחנה בין הצורך ברשת חשמל חדשה לבין החשש מפגיעה בקהילות, בחקלאות, בתיירות ובנוף, תוך שימוש בראיות.
expected_points: Campaigners accept that new grid connections are needed for renewable energy.
They object to visual, agricultural, tourism or community impacts of some routes.
They believe undergrounding could reduce those impacts and improve resilience.

tasks.prompt: Write a short response to the consultation arguing for a balanced solution. Refer to cost, landscape impact and reliability.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: התשובה צריכה להביע עמדה מאוזנת ולהתייחס במפורש לעלות, לפגיעה בנוף ולאמינות במזג אוויר קשה.
expected_points: Recognises that undergrounding can protect landscapes and improve weather resilience.
Acknowledges higher construction and maintenance costs.
Proposes underground cables or less intrusive alternatives according to local conditions.
